### `ambient.loading_story` — Narrative Loading States

Replaces a spinner with a short account of what is actually happening.

**Why it exists.** Waits feel shorter when people know what they are waiting for.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Kind | model, with an offline Reflex implementation |
| Model tier | fast |
| Surface | `transform` — Replaces the component's text in place; a provenance badge allows reverting. |
| Binds to | `Thinking`, `Skeleton`, `Progress` |
| Consent | none |
| Reads the scene | no |
| Uses registered actions | no |

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `task` | string | yes |

**Output**

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `steps` | list of string |

**Use it**

```python
# attach it to a component
ui.thinking("Composing layout").ai("ambient.loading_story")

# or call it from a handler
result = ctx.ai("ambient.loading_story", {"task": "importing a CSV of customers"})
```

**Example result** (offline Reflex engine, from the input above)

```json
{
  "steps": [
    "Reading csv",
    "Checking the details",
    "Putting it together",
    "… 1 more"
  ]
}
```

### `ambient.empathy` — Empathic Error Tone

Rephrases system messages with care when the situation is stressful — failures, losses, declines.

**Why it exists.** The moment something fails is the moment tone matters most.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Kind | model, with an offline Reflex implementation |
| Model tier | fast |
| Surface | `transform` — Replaces the component's text in place; a provenance badge allows reverting. |
| Binds to | `Callout`, `Banner`, `Text` |
| Consent | none |
| Reads the scene | no |
| Uses registered actions | no |

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | string | yes |

**Output**

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `text` | string |
| `rationale` | string |

**Use it**

```python
# attach it to a component
ui.callout("Heads up").ai("ambient.empathy")

# or call it from a handler
result = ctx.ai("ambient.empathy", {"text": "Error: payment declined! You must use a valid card."})
```

**Example result** (offline Reflex engine, from the input above)

```json

  "text": "Sorry about that. Error: payment declined. You must use a valid card.",
  "rationale": "Acknowledges the problem before instructing."
}
```

### `ambient.celebrate` — Celebration Moments

Decides whether an event deserves celebration, how much, and what to say.

**Why it exists.** Delight that fires on every click is noise; delight that fires on real milestones is memory.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Kind | model, with an offline Reflex implementation |
| Model tier | fast |
| Surface | `service` — Invoked from application code, the CLI or the developer tools. |
| Binds to | any component, or call it from code |
| Consent | none |
| Reads the scene | no |
| Uses registered actions | no |

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `event` | string | yes |

**Output**

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `celebrate` | boolean |
| `intensity` | one of `subtle`, `big` |
| `message` | string |
| `effect` | one of `none`, `check`, `confetti` |

**Use it**

```python
# or call it from a handler
result = ctx.ai("ambient.celebrate", {"event": "first invoice paid"})
```

**Example result** (offline Reflex engine, from the input above)

```json
{
  "celebrate": true,
  "intensity": "big",
  "message": "First invoice paid — nicely done.",
  "effect": "confetti"
}
```

### `ambient.nudge` — Gentle Nudges

Spots stalled work and proposes one considerate reminder, with the reason it matters now.

**Why it exists.** Reminders work when they are rare, specific and well-timed.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Kind | model, with an offline Reflex implementation |
| Model tier | fast |
| Surface | `suggest` — Chips or a ranked list rendered next to the component. |
| Binds to | `Suggestions`, `List` |
| Consent | none |
| Reads the scene | no |
| Uses registered actions | no |

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | list of object {title, idleDays} | yes |

**Output**

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `items` | list of object {label, detail, value, action, icon, score} |

**Use it**

```python
# attach it to a component
ui.suggestions().ai("ambient.nudge")

# or call it from a handler
result = ctx.ai("ambient.nudge", {"items": [{"title": "Reply to Globex renewal", "idleDays": 6}, {"title": "Review Q3 plan", "idleDays": 2}]})
```

**Example result** (offline Reflex engine, from the input above)

```json
{
  "items": [
    {
      "label": "Pick up “Reply to Globex renewal”?",
      "detail": "Untouched for 6 days.",
      "value": "Reply to Globex renewal",
      "action": null,
      "icon": "clock",
      "score": 0.8571428571428571
    }
  ]
}
```

### `ambient.sentiment` — Sentiment Lens

Reads the sentiment of customer text and summarises it as a tone, a score and the phrases that drove it.

**Why it exists.** Support queues and reviews are easier to triage when mood is visible at a glance.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Kind | model, with an offline Reflex implementation |
| Model tier | fast |
| Surface | `annotate` — An insight panel attached to the component, with confidence and provenance. |
| Binds to | `Thread`, `Text`, `List` |
| Consent | none |
| Reads the scene | no |
| Uses registered actions | no |

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | string | yes |

**Output**

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `title` | string |
| `body` | string |
| `bullets` | list of string |
| `confidence` | number |
| `tone` | one of `neutral`, `success`, `warning`, `danger`, `info`, `ai` |

**Use it**

```python
# attach it to a component
ui.thread().ai("ambient.sentiment")

# or call it from a handler
result = ctx.ai("ambient.sentiment", {"text": "The app crashed again and I am frustrated. Support was slow."})
```

**Example result** (offline Reflex engine, from the input above)

```json
{
  "title": "Negative sentiment",
  "body": "Polarity -0.60 on a −1 to 1 scale.",
  "bullets": [
    "crashed",
    "frustrated",
    "slow"
  ],
  "confidence": 0.6,
  "tone": "danger"
}
```

### `ambient.pacing` — Session Pacing

Notices long sessions and late-session error clusters, and protects the work before suggesting a pause.

**Why it exists.** Tired people make mistakes; software can save first and suggest second.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Kind | model, with an offline Reflex implementation |
| Model tier | fast |
| Surface | `observe` — Runs on interaction signals and returns adaptation directives. |
| Binds to | any component, or call it from code |
| Consent | `personalization` |
| Reads the scene | no |
| Uses registered actions | no |

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `durationMinutes` | number | yes |
| `events` | list of any | no |

**Output**

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `state` | string |
| `confidence` | number |
| `directives` | list of object {kind, target, value, reason} |

**Use it**

```python
# or call it from a handler
result = ctx.ai("ambient.pacing", {"durationMinutes": 75, "events": [{"t": 4300000, "kind": "error", "target": "amount"}, {"t": 4301000, "kind": "error", "target": "amount"}, {"t": 4302000, "kind": "error", "target": "amount"}, "… 1 more"]})
```

**Example result** (offline Reflex engine, from the input above)

```json
{
  "state": "fatigued",
  "confidence": 0.6,
  "directives": [
    {
      "kind": "suggest_break",
      "target": null,
      "value": null,
      "reason": "75 minutes of continuous work."
    },
    {
      "kind": "autosave",
      "target": null,
      "value": null,
      "reason": "Errors are clustering late in the session; protect the work."
    },
    {
      "kind": "simplify",
      "target": null,
      "value": null,
      "reason": "Reduce choices on screen until the pace recovers."
    }
  ]
}
```

### `ambient.priority` — Attention Prioritiser

Ranks everything competing for attention on a screen and names the one thing to look at first.

**Why it exists.** When everything is highlighted, nothing is.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Kind | model, with an offline Reflex implementation |
| Model tier | fast |
| Surface | `suggest` — Chips or a ranked list rendered next to the component. |
| Binds to | `List`, `Suggestions` |
| Consent | none |
| Reads the scene | no |
| Uses registered actions | no |

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | list of string | yes |

**Output**

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `items` | list of object {label, detail, value, action, icon, score} |

**Use it**

```python
# attach it to a component
ui.list().ai("ambient.priority")
```

### `ambient.greeting` — Contextual Greeting

Writes a greeting that reflects the time of day and what awaits, instead of a static “Welcome back”.

**Why it exists.** The first line of a screen sets the tone for the session.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Kind | model, with an offline Reflex implementation |
| Model tier | fast |
| Surface | `transform` — Replaces the component's text in place; a provenance badge allows reverting. |
